description: File A uses deeply nested JSON (robot → arms[] → joints[]) representing a 3-level asset hierarchy. File B represents the same data as a flat list with parent references. Tests whether the converter preserves semantic properties across different structural representations.
notes: Same semantic content, different structural organization. File A: nested (robot.arms[].joints[]). File B: flat list with parent field. The angle property maps to SemId.Qnt.ROT. Asset counts should be equal (9 total: 1 robot + 2 arms + 6 joints). The key challenge is whether the hierarchy flattening/reconstruction preserves property associations per asset.
